name: s2k_loadPat
formula: =LAMBDA(name,[selfWtMult],[DesignType],TEXTJOIN("   ", FALSE, "LoadPat=" & name, "DesignType=" & IF(ISOMITTED(DesignType), "Live", DesignType), "SelfWtMult=" & IF(ISOMITTED(selfWtMult), 0, selfWtMult), ))
comment: Returns one LOAD PATTERN DEFINITIONS record, fields separated by three spaces: LoadPat=name, DesignType, SelfWtMult. Arguments: name, optional selfWtMult (default 0), optional DesignType (default Live). No error branch. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
